techmeme.title: SoftBank reports Q2 net loss of $7B vs. a ~$15.8B profit a year ago, on ~$14B revenue vs. ~$12.8B est. as tech selloff weighs on results; shares close up 13.9% (Jenny Lee/CNBC)
GeniosAI, which develops AI software for financial analysis and modeling, raised $19.1M across seed and Series A rounds; FactSet led the Series A (Ryan Lawler/Axios)
Filings: Moonshot signed a deal in August to rent 32 China-based Super Micro servers with Nvidia B300, the most powerful AI chip, possibly in breach of US rules (Andy Lin/Bloomberg)
The White House picks Palantir CISO Michael LoSapio to lead the DHS' Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency, replacing Acting Director Nick Andersen (Reuters)
Australia is drafting legislation for an AI safety regulator empowered to impose "significant penalties" after an OpenAI model hacked a government site in Sept. (James Mayger/Bloomberg)
